Post-merge audit: **Incomplete**, 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles. Reviewer `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Exact merge `162f13f76ccae7ac026e075331d2b7b10e1d63ab`; author head `09174c2ba894cbde2c95c6f27579926edc04e2bb`.

Inspected original #1328 acceptance/closure, complete changed files and discussions, checks/annotations, source/method declarations, producer, acceptance harness, predecessor/current run receipts and later scoped history. API coverage: 26 changed files, five PR discussion comments, six original-issue comments, no formal/inline reviews, 11 checks and all 15 annotations. Pre-merge review and green CI were evidence inspected, not treated as an independent completed post-merge audit. The historical closure of #1328 is preserved.

Whole-byte verification: all 26 changed original files/modes match head and merge, totaling 27,901,388 bytes. All 90 whole descriptors were authenticated against immutable Git bytes/modes (98,863,439 unique encoded bytes). The complete original Philippines source gzip was actually decoded and CRC/hash checked: it yields exactly 7,071,267 bytes, SHA-256 `2ece3d44a5c6a2afb385ffbf3a6b88d83e4d3a3e7eed9a52cb3be1bc59e289fc`, matching the retained consumed raw source with 1,647 complete features. The previous producer and run receipt remain exact preserved bytes. Both historical successful run inventories match all five actual retained output files; this verifies retained evidence, not newly reexecuted full runs.

Actual isolated read-only checks at this merge: imported only the guarded original extractor; inspected the top-level acceptance harness without executing it. Derived the 22 contact subjects from original issue acceptance. Selected all 22 original features from the complete source and matched retained records; independently selected all 22 current features from whole pinned parts 18/19 and matched records and binding hashes. All 22 actual candidate binding calls matched retained candidate records. Six actual rejection controls passed: omitted, duplicated and foreign subject, changed whole-source bytes, changed current content and the exact candidate-longitude counterexample. The latter produces full-feature SHA `1d7c4f173ac5456e2366ecc85b84b922d41e29a79881afe1f1157afae0978571` and is rejected. Candidate calls used retained proposal routing hashes; full original routing-row decoding remains unchecked.

Actionable finding: **#1500 (open, ready)** records a deduplicated additive correction to this extraction/acceptance operation. Its unchanged actual writer passed a fresh-file positive but replaced an existing original-vintage sentinel, followed a dangling leaf symlink and followed a symlink parent into private sibling destinations. All test paths were inside the auditor-owned review scratch; original packets remained byte-identical. Inspected producer/harness paths show those writes replace retained records/receipts in their documented normal use. Full evidence, defect, bounded reproduction, scope and success criteria are on #1500, which has `follow-up`, `urgent`, `type:geography`, exact subjects/pins, closed dependency #1328 and a distinct one-PR namespace. Shared read-only readiness review returned complete/eligible with no findings; no implementation claim was acquired.

The same follow-up covers missing complete-operation admission: the producer concatenates routing inputs into logical component/family streams of 208,391,779 and 111,223,285 bytes, each above the 33,554,432-byte body cap. The retained whole closure declares a minimum 531,409,507 unique encoded/additional-decoded bytes before further outputs/runtime, above the 268,435,456-byte phase cap. All encoded hashes/sizes were checked; the other 57 gzip files' footer lengths match retained decoded lengths. Their complete decoded contents/hashes/CRC were **not** verified. These admission figures are retained closure/footer evidence corroborated by the actual code path, not fresh full reproduction. Splitting descriptors does not authorize that same oversized operation.

Remaining verification: full producer/acceptance CLI, complete routing/physical decoded rows and independent comparison of those rows with all 22 assessments/ten families; full frozen runtime/method closure and two fresh original full extraction runs; source-fitness conclusions and primary-source authority, represented date, CRS, derivative/reuse terms and contact crosswalk claims; finite independent physical/admin evidence and source-cause interpretations. Primary materials retained only as restoration context do not establish authenticated source fitness. Municipal/current-code checks do not prove 2020 legal boundaries. No geography approval, import, deployment or parent #1202 completion is claimed.

Next step: audit #1500's bounded actual admission/preservation correction separately when merged, then verify any remaining complete original operation only through an authorized genuinely admissible method and continue independent source/method review. A successful refusal or closed follow-up does not complete this original scientific/source audit. Unique scratch and test receipts are preserved; the owned managed review slot is released after this durable result. #726 retains this row as Incomplete with #1500's actual state.
